classes.description: No mutation of any kind. Read-only status checks, queue reads, PR status, git status, and other read-only views. Maps to T0 tier in approval_policy.yaml.
Local analysis operations: packet validation, proof validation, diff inspection, decision-affecting local analysis. No write side effects. Maps to T1 tier. Receipt required.
Draft artifact writes: draft plans, draft proof, temporary markdown, non-authoritative draft artifacts. Maps to T2 tier. Approval required; not a canonical write.
Documentation updates and command documentation under an active Task Packet. Maps to T3 tier. Approval required; gated decision.
Schema and contract file writes (schemas/dcp/, schemas/pr_steward/, etc.). Maps to T4 tier with canonical_writer=proof-bundle-governance. Requires approval, receipt, and proof artifact.
known_unknowns: promotion path from PROVISIONAL to REPO_CROSS_CHECKED for schema contracts not yet defined

classes.description: Proof bundle writes to proof/ directory. Maps to T4 tier with canonical_writer=proof-bundle-governance. Proof freshness statuses from proof.py ALLOWED_PROOF_STATUSES apply.
known_unknowns: proof/ is gitignored; git add -f required per TP-DCP-0001 convention

classes.description: Code edits, config edits, ConPort writes, workflow transitions, and index sync. Maps to T4 tier (mode=write). Approval, receipt, and gated decision required.
classes.mutation_surface: src/ and config/ source and config files

classes.description: CI workflow file edits (.github/workflows/), config mutations, and related build/deployment config. Maps to T4 tier (config edits). Approval required. Potential T6 escalation for deploy/release configs.
known_unknowns: CI-specific sub-capabilities not enumerated in approval_policy.yaml; tier boundary between T4 and T6 for deploy configs is PROVISIONAL

classes.description: Writes to ConPort structured context, decisions, progress, and custom data. Maps to T4 tier with canonical_writer=ConPort (from orchestrator.memory.record_decision and orchestrator.memory.record_progress capabilities).
known_unknowns: ConPort deployed-primary endpoint binding PROVISIONAL (port 5455 from MCP docs, not runtime-proven)

classes.description: Writes to task-orchestrator workflow state (transitions, item advances). Maps to T4 tier with canonical_writer=task-orchestrator (orchestrator.transition.apply capability). Task-Orchestrator is not DCP authority.
known_unknowns: task-orchestrator runtime authority partially conflicted per ARCHITECTURE.md §4 note on app/main.py vs Docker startup wiring

classes.description: Writes to dope-memory chronicle, working-memory-assistant, or dope-context index. Maps to T4 tier. dope-memory is mirror_writer (ConPort is canonical) per policy.py orchestrator.memory.record_progress capability.
known_unknowns: dope-memory vs ConPort split authority not resolved per ARCHITECTURE.md §3.4; durable ledger authority and snapshot/recovery support are distinct concerns

classes.description: PR comments, labels, merges, pushes, and related GitHub mutations. Maps to T5 tier with canonical_writer=GitHub. orchestrator.github.merge requires typed_confirmation_required=true.
known_unknowns: typed_confirmation_required varies by sub-action (merge=true, comment=false per approval_policy.yaml capabilities)

classes.description: Index clearing, deploys, force pushes, record deletes, and release operations. Maps to T6 tier (mode=destructive). typed_confirmation_required=true. orchestrator.destructive.clear_index uses decision=block.
classes.mutation_surface: dope-context indexes; deployment targets; release artifacts

classes.description: External Dopetask execution via scripts/taskx → scripts/dopetask → external dopetask. No explicit tier in approval_policy.yaml. Execution plane owned by wrapper path only (ARCHITECTURE.md §3.2). DCP may describe this class but must not execute Dopetask.
known_unknowns: No approval_policy.yaml capability for Dopetask execution — tier is PROVISIONAL
Wrapper path observed (scripts/taskx, scripts/dopetask) but external dopetask implementation out of scope
DCP must not execute Dopetask per TP-DCP-0002 §5 OUT scope
classes.mutation_surface: external dopetask runtime (out of scope for DCP .v0)

classes.description: Writes mediated through dopecon-bridge or another proxy. The bridge_mediated=true field exists in policy.py CapabilityPolicy. orchestrator.route.pm is TX (refuse) with bridge_mediated=true. Bridge-mediated writes are refused by default until explicitly classified.
known_unknowns: orchestrator.route.pm is TX (refuse); bridge-mediated writes have no automatic tier classification
upstream_canonical_writer required per policy.py for bridge-mediated writes but not currently resolvable
dopecon-bridge runtime explicitly denies domain authority (ARCHITECTURE.md §3.6)

classes.description: CRM, channel, or external service writes. No explicit capability in approval_policy.yaml. Tier inferred as T5/T6 by analogy to GitHub mutation posture. DCP-RED-IDENTITY-CONTACT-MERGE-DESTRUCTIVE-EXTERNAL-WRITE applies.
known_unknowns: No explicit capability in approval_policy.yaml for CRM/channel writes
Tier inferred from T5/T6 external mutation posture — PROVISIONAL until capability registered
